answer: Run cross-epoch consistency checks. Each epoch, 3 of an account's past answers are re-asked as hidden probes 10 epochs later, and the new reply must match the graded facts at 80% or better. An honest agent only has to remember its own work. A 1,000-puppet farm must keep 1,000 separate persona histories and produce about 3,000 extra consistent replies every epoch, or it loses its rewards. Like a bridge over karst, trust holds only where each span rests on earlier ground, not a marble facade.
